**www.rkkp.dk** is the official website for [[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]] (The Regions' Clinical Quality Development Program) [^src1]. It serves as the primary digital hub and administrative source for the program's publications, including the annual report for the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark) covering the period from July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023 [^src1]. 

Within the context of the 2022–2023 atrial fibrillation annual report, the website is cited repeatedly across multiple pages as the definitive point of reference for the program [^src1]. The reports hosted and administered through this domain detail critical healthcare metrics, including methodological frameworks for data collection, eight specific clinical quality indicators, and comprehensive results regarding patient wait times for anticoagulation treatment across national, regional, and hospital levels [^src1]. By integrating clinical guidelines and data protection regulations, the resources provided via www.rkkp.dk form a vital technical and clinical documentation backbone for evaluating the quality of atrial fibrillation treatment in the Danish healthcare system [^src1].
